stages.discovery: A blacksmith's shop stands with its chimney cold and its forge unlit, tools still hung neat along the wall the way a careful smith leaves them at the end of a working day - not the way anyone leaves them for good. An unfinished blade sits clamped in the vice, half-shaped and never finished.

choices.label: Finish the Blade Yourself
choices.description: The forge is cold, but the tools still work
choices.outcome: You're no smith, but you know enough to knock the rough edges smooth and give the blade a working edge. It isn't fine work, but it isn't nothing either.

choices.label: Search the Workshop
choices.description: A smithy this well-kept might have coin stashed somewhere - Perception check

check.success_outcome: You spot a loose brick near the forge and find a tin of savings behind it, the kind of quiet stash a working smith keeps against a bad season. You take it with a twinge of guilt you can't quite place.
check.failure_outcome: You go over the workshop but nothing stands out as anything other than what it looks like - a smith's ordinary tools, nothing hidden.

choices.label: Leave the Forge Cold
choices.description: ESC also cancels - it isn't your workshop to touch
choices.outcome: You leave the unfinished blade exactly as you found it and step back out into the gray daylight.
